text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Training's done... for now. Guess I'll 
wash up and head back to my room—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoever uses the last of the hand soap 
should at least refill it. ...Tch."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Where's the stock? Man, what a pain...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, Sirius Symboli was 
left searching for hand soap refills...
